note: Regex numbers are recomputed and asserted equal to results.json (LUM-996/998), not copied. Latency fields are wall-clock measurements and vary between runs/machines; everything else is deterministic for a given cache.

plainAgentAddressedSlice.note: Hand-written before any scoring; outside every pool and never used for threshold choice (pure held-out). See plain-agent-addressed.ts.

thresholdChoice.rule: lowest grid value with TRAIN Lumo-benign FPR ≤ 1%

chunking.rule: texts over 510 content tokens are split into consecutive 510-token windows; any chunk flagged → flagged (max probability)
